territorial_scope.description: Applies to public entities and to private entities linked to critical services in Uruguay.

evidence.quote: El presente Decreto será de aplicación a todas las entidades públicas, y a las entidades privadas vinculadas a servicios o sectores críticos del país.

summary.short: Sets cybersecurity duties for Uruguayan public entities and private entities linked to critical services: 24-hour incident reporting, a national cybersecurity framework with maturity levels, audits and transparency. Implements Laws 18.046, 18.172, 18.362, 18.719 and 20.212 (Arts. 78-84) and was published on 14/03/2025.
summary.long: Decree 66/025 implements Laws 18.046 (Art. 55), 18.172 (Art. 119), 18.362 (Art. 73), 18.719 (Art. 149) and 20.212 (Arts. 78-84) on information security and cybersecurity. It applies to all public entities and to private entities linked to critical services (Art. 2). It assigns functions to the Directorate of Information Security of AGESIC, including issuing regulations, auditing compliance and advising the Executive (Arts. 1, 4, 5). The CERTuy response centre coordinates incident response and handles the national incident register (Arts. 7-9). Covered entities must adopt safeguards, designate an information security officer, keep audit logs for at least 12 months, report incidents to CERTuy within 24 hours, adopt the Cybersecurity Framework at a minimum maturity level, audit it, and send audit summaries within 30 days (Arts. 10-17). Outsourced services must meet the Framework (Art. 18). AGESIC publishes maturity indicators (Art. 19) and sets security criteria for public procurement (Art. 20). Art. 20-BIS, added by Decree 168/026 of 17/07/2026, sets incident procedures for central administration bodies. AGESIC may issue reprimands and reports non-compliant entities semi-annually to the General Assembly (Art. 21); the text states no fines. Decrees 451/009 and 452/009 are repealed (Art. 22).

thresholds.variable_text: servicio que afecte a más del 30% de la población
thresholds.value_text: más del 30% (treinta por ciento) de la población
thresholds.measurement: Share of the population affected by the service. The text states no time window, aggregation method or measuring body.
thresholds.consequence: A service affecting more than 30% of the population is a critical service, which brings linked public and private entities within the decree's scope (Art. 2).
thresholds.conditions: Applies to services outside the enumerated critical sectors, as the alternative category ('cualquier otro servicio') in the definition of critical services.

evidence.quote: cualquier otro servicio que afecte a más del 30% (treinta por ciento) de la población
